scope: Rust workspace, native CLI, Git and native transports, object/cache/storage boundaries, automation client and CI configuration

findings.impact: Repository entries could install Git control files or nested kasu working-copy metadata. Apple filesystem aliases could bypass ASCII-only checks.
findings.fix: Reserve .git and .kasu at every path component, including HFS ignorable characters and Unicode case-fold aliases. Validate before checkout mutation.
findings.compatibility: Repositories containing reserved control components are rejected; ordinary byte paths, .gitignore and .gitmodules remain supported.

findings.impact: Outgoing gRPC authorization metadata could expose bearer tokens in debug output.
findings.fix: Mark bearer metadata sensitive and reuse the common constructor in the CLI.

findings.impact: A non-UTF-8 KASU_TOKEN was included in the propagated environment error.
findings.fix: Use a fixed error message and validate environment tokens before starting listeners.

findings.impact: Oversized local compressed objects were fully allocated before downstream size checks.
findings.fix: Share the 257 MiB compressed-object cap across storage and transport; check file metadata, bound the read, and reject oversized input before decompression.
findings.compatibility: Oversized compressed representations are rejected even if their decompressed contents would fit.

reviewed_boundaries: Bearer/Basic authentication, account and hop credential separation, scoped native reads and Git projections
Write-policy intersection, ref/path permissions, object membership and guarded publication
Canonical decoding, pkt-line/pack framing, delta expansion limits and compressed object validation
CLI checkout path validation, no-follow filesystem operations, transaction recovery and virtual lower-tree validation
Cache scope, snapshot manifest/frame bounds, daemon socket ownership and private directory checks
PostgreSQL TLS and parameterized queries, S3 TLS and bounded frame retrieval
Webhook URL validation, redirect policy and signatures; automation transport bounds and redirect rejection
Admission capacity, cancellation and request budgets; CI permissions and dependency policy

validation.dependency_policy: cargo deny check passed (duplicate-version warnings only)
validation.workspace_all_features: passed: 225 tests, 0 failures, 21 ignored; the final CLI Unicode alias additions were subsequently validated by the native unit suite and complete Linux CLI suite
validation.linux_cli: passed: 24 tests, 0 failures, 1 privileged FUSE test ignored
validation.clippy: passed: workspace, all targets, all features, warnings denied

limitations: This is a source and regression-test audit, not a guarantee that all vulnerabilities are absent.
Tests requiring PostgreSQL/S3 services, privileged FUSE mounts, root OpenSSH, external Git clients or pinned external repositories are not included in the normal workspace test run.
APFS Kelvin-sign and long-s aliases were reproduced on the host; HFS ignorable-character checks have portable regression coverage, not a mounted HFS filesystem test.
